membership: Every latest durable prospective opportunity state whose decision timestamp is in the registered validation interval. Only JOINED rows may receive outcomes; every rejected or pending state remains reported with its reason.
model_replay: Load each selected development binary only after its SHA-256 matches the frozen manifest. Preserve market, policy family, model class, feature order and decision threshold. Retraining, refitting and retuning are forbidden.
costs: Use the selected policy family and the market-specific NORMAL_P75 and STRESSED_P95 spread percentiles already frozen from development. Validation spread observations may be reported but may not recalibrate costs.
pass_rule: For locked predicted trades, require at least 10 evaluable trades, NORMAL_P75 and STRESSED_P95 profit factor strictly above 1, and NORMAL_P75 and STRESSED_P95 trade expectancy strictly above 0. Any missing selected-market artifact, changed evidence hash or fewer than 10 evaluable trades fails validation.
ambiguous_or_unverifiable: Retain the status and reason, exclude it from economic arithmetic and count it against evidence completeness; never convert it to a loss or favorable fill.
